_comment: Copy this file to the path given by ROSTER_PATH (compose mounts it read-only at /config/roster.json)
and replace EVERY authToken with a fresh random secret:  openssl rand -hex 24
Whitelist rule enforced by the server (never by the UI):
A may call B  <=>  B is listed in A.allowlist  AND  A is listed in B.allowlist.
A frame therefore reaches exactly the people in its own allowlist, and is reachable by
exactly those same people. An empty or missing allowlist means the peer can neither call
nor be called. Keep the lists symmetric; the server logs a warning for one-sided entries.
kind: 'frame' = a tablet at the grandparents, 'family' = a phone/laptop of a family member.
The file is re-read automatically when its mtime changes (and on SIGHUP), so peers can be
ONE PEER PER PERSON, NOT ONE PER HOUSEHOLD. The signalling server allows exactly one live
socket per peer id: a second socket registering the same id closes the first with
'session-replaced'. If ion and maria shared a peer id, their two phones would kick each
other offline in a loop for as long as both apps are open, and neither could be called.
Every admin account in admins.json must therefore point at its OWN peer here.
The ids below are placeholders: rename them to suit your family, and keep them in sync
deploy.sh replaces every 'replace-me' token with a random one when it seeds roster.json.
The server refuses to start while any 'replace-me' token is left.
